334:     func runSearch() {
335:         let trimmed = query.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
336:         guard !trimmed.isEmpty else {
337:             clearResults()
338:             return
339:         }
340:         guard !(isSearching && submittedConfiguration == requestConfiguration) else { return }
341:         stopEngineWork()
342:         submittedConfiguration = requestConfiguration
343:         configurationInvalidated = false
344:         hasSubmitted = true
345:         wasCancelled = false
346:         errorMessage = nil
347:         hasMore = false
348:         guard availableScopes.contains(scope) else {
349:             results = []
350:             errorMessage = "שיטת חיפוש זו אינה נתמכת במקור הפעיל. בחרו שיטה זמינה."
351:             return
352:         }
353:         if let message = optionsValidationMessage {
354:             results = []
355:             errorMessage = message
356:             return
357:         }
358:         submissionRevision += 1
359:         acceptsEngineUpdates = true
360:         resultKitabFilter = ""
361:         allowsAutomaticPaging = true
362:         #if os(iOS)
363:         searchViewModel?.addToHistory(trimmed)
364:         #endif
365:         #if DEBUG
366:         NSLog("[GlobalSearch] submit revision=%d generation=%d backend=%@ scope=%@", submissionRevision, searchGeneration,
367:               BackendCoordinator.shared.activeBackendID.rawValue, scope.rawValue)
368:         #endif
369: 
370:         if isSefaria {
371:             runSefariaSearch(query: trimmed)
372:         } else if scope == .zayit {
373:             runZayitSearch(query: trimmed)
374:         } else {
375:             runOtzariaSearch(query: trimmed)
376:         }

400:         // Preserve provider fidelity through SearchViewModel.effectiveBackendSearchOptions().
401:         // Phrase enforces exact; contains enforces Hebrew lemmatization; near preserves match mode.
402:         if !supportsSefariaOptions || scope == .exact {
403:             searchViewModel.searchMode = .phrase

582:     func searchInBook(_ item: SearchResultItem) {
583:         let resolvedBookId: Int?
584:         if let book = resolveBook(from: item) {
585:             resolvedBookId = book.id
586:         } else if item.bookId > 0 {
587:             resolvedBookId = item.bookId
588:         } else {
589:             let table: String
590:             if item.tableName.hasPrefix("otzaria:") {
591:                 table = String(item.tableName.dropFirst("otzaria:".count))
592:             } else if item.tableName.hasPrefix("b") {
593:                 table = String(item.tableName.dropFirst())
594:             } else {
595:                 table = item.tableName
596:             }
597:             resolvedBookId = Int(table)
598:         }
599: 
600:         guard let bookId = resolvedBookId, bookId > 0 else { return }
601:         selectedBookIds = [bookId]
602:         resultKitabFilter = ""
603:         searchViewModel?.setSelectedBooks([bookId])
604:         runSearch()
605:     }

607:     func openResult(_ item: SearchResultItem, using manager: iOSNavigationManager) {

619:             ZayitSearchReaderNavigationAdapter.open(hit, using: manager)
620:             return
621:         }
622: 
623:         if let book = resolveBook(from: item) {
624:             let shouldRecord = UserDefaults.standard.recordSearchHistory
625:             let targetContentId: Int
626:             if let backendLocator = item.backendLocator {
627:                 let resolved = ReaderDestinationResolver.resolve(locator: backendLocator)
628:                 targetContentId = LegacyIdentityRegistry.shared.id(for: resolved.sectionLocator)
679:             let resolved = ReaderDestinationResolver.resolve(locator: locator)
680:             return MaktabahBackendAdapter.resolveBook(for: resolved.sectionLocator, in: LibraryDataManager.shared)
681:         }
682:         return OtzariaSearchResultResolver.resolveBook(
683:             from: item,
684:             libraryDataManager: LibraryDataManager.shared

8: import Foundation
9: 
10: @MainActor
11: final class SearchHitResolver {
12:     static let shared = SearchHitResolver()
13: 
14:     private let cache = NSCache<NSString, NSAttributedString>()
15: 
16:     private init() {
17:         cache.countLimit = 1000
18:     }
19: 
20:     func clearCache() {
21:         cache.removeAllObjects()
22:     }
23: 
24:     func cachedSnippet(for item: SearchResultItem) -> NSAttributedString? {
25:         cache.object(forKey: item.id as NSString)
26:     }
27: 
28:     func resolveSnippet(
29:         for item: SearchResultItem,
30:         keywords: [String],
31:         mode: SearchMode,
32:         nearDistance: Int,
33:     ) async -> NSAttributedString? {
34:         let key = item.id as NSString
35:         if let cached = cache.object(forKey: key) {
36:             return cached
37:         }
38: 
39:         guard let payload = await Task.detached(priority: .userInitiated, operation: { () -> (snippet: String, keywords: [String])? in
40:             guard let content = await LibraryDataManager.shared.fetchSingleContent(
41:                 archive: item.archive,
42:                 table: item.tableName,
43:                 rowId: item.bookId
44:             ) else {
45:                 return nil
46:             }
47: 
48:             let bookId = Int(item.tableName.dropFirst()) ?? 0
49:             let book = LibraryDataManager.shared.getBook([bookId]).first
50:             let isMultilingual = book?.isMultiLanguage ?? false
51:             let isImported = book?.isImported ?? false
52: 
53:             let cleaned = content.nash.cleaningLineBreaks()
54:             let stripped = isImported ? cleaned.stripSpanTags() : cleaned
55:             let normalized = stripped.convertToArabicDigits(isMultilingual: isMultilingual)
56:             let keywordsConverted = keywords.map { $0.convertToArabicDigits(isMultilingual: isMultilingual) }
57: 
58:             let snippet: String
59:             if mode == .near {
60:                 snippet = normalized
61:                     .normalizeArabic()
62:                     .snippetNear(keywords: keywordsConverted, nearDistance: nearDistance, contextLength: 60)
63:             } else {
64:                 snippet = normalized
65:                     .normalizeArabic()
66:                     .snippetAround(keywords: keywordsConverted, contextLength: 60)
67:             }
68: 
69:             return (snippet, keywordsConverted)
70:         }).value else {
71:             return nil
72:         }
73: 
74:         let attributed: NSAttributedString
75:         if mode == .near {
76:             attributed = payload.snippet.highlightedAttributedText(keywords: payload.keywords, nearDistance: nearDistance)
77:         } else {
78:             attributed = payload.snippet.highlightedAttributedText(keywords: payload.keywords)
79:         }
80: 
81:         cache.setObject(attributed, forKey: key)
82:         return attributed
83:     }
84: }
